column1: # Per-row disposition exceptions: authored input to the Web IDL census.
# Three tab-separated fields: <row id> <disposition> <reason>. An override
# whose row id matches no row fails generation, so an entry cannot outlive
# Empty at Q1. Every one of the 121 rows is described by its own section's
# line in census/webidl/dispositions.tsv, and the two rows the survey singled
# out for ratification are section-wide rulings rather than exceptions:
# "mark a promise as handled" is owned with the rest of
# js-promise-manipulation although the pinned Streams source invokes it zero
# times (ruling R-P4), and idl-DOMException-derived-predefineds is hostOnly
# for the whole section rather than evidenceOnly for the worked instance.
